beforeImage.name: Stem Energy Storage Asset SPVs
beforeImage.description: Stem Energy Storage Asset SPVs are financing vehicles for behind-the-meter battery storage projects. Their end users are commercial and grid-facing customers that use storage to reduce energy costs, provide local capacity, and support utility programs. The model is asset-heavy and contract-based, with project value tied to financed storage systems and long-term software and services support from Stem. Public reporting identified Generate Capital as a primary Stem project-financing provider in 2016, and Generate's published materials later described a program with the right to fund up to 85 MW / 340 MWh of Southern California behind-the-meter storage projects. The reviewed materials did not disclose individual SPV ownership percentages or portfolio-level revenue. Generate's relationship with Stem therefore centers on project and asset financing, while Stem remains the technology and software provider.

milestones.event: Stem's project-financing pool included primary project financing from Generate Capital for behind-the-meter storage deployments.

afterImage.name: Generate–Stem LCR
afterImage.description: Generate-Stem LCR, LLC is a Delaware special-purpose vehicle formed on June 30, 2017 to purchase and own behind-the-meter battery-storage systems supporting Southern California Edison's West Los Angeles Basin local-capacity program. Stem, Inc. holds a 50% Class B non-managing interest and remains the host-facing technology and operating counterparty. Stem's filings describe a two-class structure and its 50% interest, so the Generate-linked Class A managing interest is recorded as an inferred 50%; the exact Generate affiliate and fund are not publicly disclosed. The cited 85 MW / 340 MWh figures are contract and funding ceilings rather than verified deployed capacity. Stem continued to report obligations and repayments for its consolidated SPE program through June 30, 2026, and no sale, transfer, foreclosure, dissolution or signed pending ownership transaction for Generate-Stem LCR was identified through August 29, 2026.
